tasks.label: Sync LAN IP to .env
tasks.command: LAN_IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || ipconfig getifaddr en1 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [ -n "$LAN_IP" ]; then sed -i '' "s|^API_BASE_URL=.*|API_BASE_URL=http://${LAN_IP}:8080/api/v1|" .env; sed -i '' "s|^WS_BASE_URL=.*|WS_BASE_URL=ws://${LAN_IP}:8080/ws|" .env; echo "[Vithey] Synced LAN IP: http://${LAN_IP}:8080/api/v1"; fi
